Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst with strong Business Intelligence, data analytics and HR domain expertise to help turn business needs into fast, flexible, data-driven solutions.
 The role will focus on HR analytics and agentic AI , leveraging technologies such as Joule Work to enable smarter, more automated and self-service analytics.
 Key Responsibilities 
Translate HR and business requirements into data analysis, insights and actionable solutions .
Develop BI and analytics solutions supporting HR, workforce and organizational topics.
Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities and risks and communicate insights to stakeholders.
Work closely with HR, business and technology teams to respond quickly to analytical demands.
Explore and implement agentic analytics and AI-powered solutions , including use cases with Joule Work.
Apply data science and advanced analytical techniques where appropriate.
Improve analytics processes through automation, reusable solutions and AI .
Ensure analytical outputs are reliable, meaningful and aligned with business requirements.
 Requirements 
Minimum 5 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science or a related field .
Strong HR domain knowledge , including understanding of HR processes, workforce data and organizational structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently with ambiguous requirements.
Experience translating business questions into data-driven insights and solutions .
Good understanding of data modelling, data quality and analytical methodologies.
Experience with BI/data analytics tools and technologies.
Interest or experience in Generative AI, agentic AI and AI-powered analytics .
 Nice to Have 
Experience with SAP and understanding of SAP as a company, including its organizational structures and business processes.
Experience with data science, predictive analytics or advanced analytics .
Exposure to Joule Work or agentic AI .
Experience in large, complex international organizations.
 For more information – please apply for this job directly.
